decisions.target_truth: Keep anywhere = at/in/to any place; current owner is simple and coherent.
Keep spatial/separation core plus high-value apart from construction; current target truth is coherent.

Keep ordinary apartment = self-contained set of rooms/home. Remove or sharply downgrade the embedded A-priority word-family fact 'apartment = apart + ment'; it is not a useful learner semantic relation and overstates transparent compositionality.
Keep noun ape and verb ape=imitate/mimic; both are ordinary modern meanings.
Keep apologise = express regret, with apologise to sb for sth / apologise for sth; owner is coherent.

Center ordinary apology = expression of regret, including apology to sb / apology for sth. Do not let the rare formal-defense sense own the generic pattern 'an apology for sth'; demote formal defense and 'a poor example/an apology for a...' to lower recognition/reference.
Keep appal/appalled = shock or horrify greatly; current active pattern is coherent.

Keep equipment/device-system sense as core. Add high-value institutional/organizational system use such as state/government apparatus for academic reading. Downgrade specialized biological 'group of body parts' application from equal main prominence.
Preserve the important contrast: apparent=clearly evident/obvious vs apparent=seeming but not necessarily true.

Preserve request/plea, attractiveness, legal appeal, and their noun counterparts, but collapse redundant learner objects: legal appeal must not appear simultaneously as active sense plus secondary_sense, and appeal-to patterns already represented by fixed-pattern collocations must not create competing semantic objects.

Keep three learner centers: come into view/occur, seem, and appear in an official/publication/performance context where useful. Reorganize current overlap between 'come into sight' and 'come into being/on the scene'; do not place appear in court/at a meeting under a mismatched come-into-being definition.

Center appearance=the way something looks and appearance=act/occasion of appearing, including court/public appearance as an application. Demote/remove the weak 'mental representation or impression' branch from main Active learner content and avoid unnecessary dictionary-style splitting.
Keep document appendix and anatomical appendix; both are common, distinct, and useful meanings.
Keep literal desire for food and figurative appetite for knowledge/power/etc.; extension is natural and high value.
Keep intransitive clap to show approval and transitive approve/praise; distinction is useful and coherent.
Single ordinary noun meaning approval shown by clapping is correct and sufficient.
Single ordinary fruit noun is correct and sufficient.
Keep household appliance and broader specialized device/instrument use; both are ordinary enough and semantically aligned.

Keep applicable = relevant/able to be applied, especially applicable to. The construction is explicitly presentation-merged into its fixed-pattern collocation, so it does not establish a competing learner meaning.
Keep application=putting something to use, formal request, and software/application program; all three are common high-value branches. Existing apply/applicable family links are semantically aligned.

notes: Truth-stage artifact only: no Word or Relation semantics were mutated.
Owner-level verdict includes embedded word-family/deep facts; a correct headword sense does not earn PASS when its owner contains a misleading learner fact.
